headlines.title: Two violating oil tankers explode on unauthorized route in Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA — The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy Public Relations announced that two violating oil tankers exploded on the unauthorized route of the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Israel seeks to drag US into another war with chemical weapons allegations: Iran FM
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has condemned Israeli allegations that Iran is pursuing chemical weapons, describing them as an attempt to mislead the United States and draw it into another war.

headlines.title: Iran tightens security measures in Strait of Hormuz: Army
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia says the military had stepped up surveillance and control of the Strait of Hormuz, warning that vessels must coordinate their passage with the Iranian Armed Forces to ensure safe transit.

headlines.title: Iran prepared to withstand naval blockade: VP Aref
headlines.snippet: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref says that the country is not concerned about a US-imposed naval blockade, pointing to a significant increase in the unloading and clearance of essential goods through its northern and other non-southern borders.

headlines.title: Violating oil tanker catches fire east of Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – The Iranian Army Navy reported a fire aboard an oil tanker east of the Strait of Hormuz, stating that the vessel was immobilized after striking a naval mine.

headlines.title: LNG carrier strikes sea mine, explodes in Hormuz: IRGC
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – The IRGC said Wednesday evening that an LNG carrier struck a naval mine and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after switching off its positioning system and taking an unsafe route.

headlines.title: “How many drones and ships did you lose today?”
headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 25 (MNA) – Destroying a number of US vessels and drones in recent days, a spokesman for the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) mocked the US Central Command (CENTCOM), saying it how many ships and drones did you lose?

headlines.snippet: TEHRAN, Nov. 26 (MNA) – The spokesman for the Yemeni Armed Forces Brigadier General Yahya Saree announced in a statement two strikes on Jeddah and Jizan Ports in response to the Saudi aggression on Hodeidah Port.

headlines.title: 1 Iran develops new ballistic missile variants, US think tanks say

headlines.title: 2 INSIGHT Persian Gulf oil exports near prewar levels despite Hormuz attacks
headlines.snippet: Oil exports from Persian Gulf producers outside Iran have nearly returned to prewar levels despite attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, with Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates surpassing their prewar crude and condensate export volumes, Kpler data show.

headlines.title: 3 INSIGHT Iran faces year-end cash squeeze if US blockade holds

headlines.title: 4 ANALYSIS Iran’s disillusionment with Russia and China grows across political camps
